observations: invoice(id, actor) loads an item via load(id) and returns item.amount without any owner check.
The stated behavior contract requires returning the amount only to the owner and throwing an Error for other actors.
load(id) returns a fixed object with owner "alice" and amount 40 for any id, including id=7.
Probe p1 calls invoice(7, "bob") where actor "bob" is not the owner "alice".
Probe p2 calls invoice(7, "alice") where actor matches the owner.
No authorization or ownership comparison appears in the changed lines 2-4.
